security_audit.summary: Review found 50 false positives caused by Markdown formatting, expected Azure endpoints, scoped environment access, and a streaming recommendation. The fixed local download path can overwrite data, and cloud deletion examples lack confirmation safeguards.

remediation.issue: The local download example can truncate an existing file.
remediation.suggestion: Accept a caller-provided destination and require explicit overwrite approval when the path already exists.

remediation.issue: Share, directory, and file deletion examples omit safety checks.
remediation.suggestion: Require confirmation of exact resource identifiers and recommend a snapshot or backup before destructive operations.

content.user_title: Manage Azure File Shares with Python
content.value_statement: Azure Files workflows require correct authentication and SDK client usage. This skill provides focused Python examples for shares, directories, files, snapshots, ranges, and async operations.
actual_capabilities: Configure ShareServiceClient with a connection string or DefaultAzureCredential.
Create, list, access, and delete Azure file shares.
Create directories and list directory or file entries.
Upload, download, copy, inspect, and delete files.
Use byte ranges, streaming downloads, and share snapshots.
Build asynchronous file uploads with explicit client cleanup.
limitations: Requires the Azure Storage File Share and Azure Identity Python packages.
Requires valid Azure credentials, network access, and appropriate RBAC permissions.
Examples use placeholders and need environment-specific names, URLs, and policies.
Does not provision storage accounts or validate production security settings.

use_cases.title: Add Azure file storage
use_cases.description: Connect a Python service to Azure Files and implement routine upload, download, listing, and metadata operations.

use_cases.title: Operate shared cloud files
use_cases.description: Manage shares, directories, quotas, snapshots, and cleanup workflows for hosted applications.

use_cases.title: Move large datasets
use_cases.description: Stream large files, transfer selected ranges, and use asynchronous clients for scalable data movement.

prompt_templates.title: Connect with Entra ID
prompt_templates.prompt: Show how to connect a Python application to Azure Files using Entra ID. Use placeholders and explain the required account URL.

prompt_templates.title: Build a file workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Python workflow for share [share], directory [directory], and file [file]. Include upload, listing, properties, and download steps.

prompt_templates.title: Stream a large download
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a memory-efficient Python download from Azure Files to [destination]. Include chunking, destination validation, error handling, and overwrite confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Review production readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Azure Files Python workflow: [description]. Check RBAC, retries, chunking, snapshots, quotas, deletion safeguards, and asynchronous resource closure.

output_examples.input: List available shares and explain their quotas.
output: Uses the service client to enumerate shares.
Reports each share name and quota in gigabytes.
Notes the required authentication and listing permission.

output_examples.input: Plan a safe download of a large file.
output: Validates the remote path and local destination.
Requests overwrite approval when the destination exists.
Streams chunks to limit memory use and reports transfer failures.
Lists the exact target resources before deletion.
Creates or verifies a recovery snapshot when appropriate.
Requires explicit confirmation before each destructive operation.

best_practices: Use Entra ID with least-privilege RBAC for production workloads.
Stream large files and close asynchronous clients and credentials explicitly.
Create snapshots and verify targets before destructive changes.
anti_patterns: Do not place connection strings or account keys directly in source code.
Do not overwrite local files or delete cloud resources without confirmation.
Do not read large files fully into memory when streaming is available.

faq.question: Which Python packages are required?
faq.answer: Install azure-storage-file-share. Install azure-identity when using Entra ID or DefaultAzureCredential.

faq.question: Can this skill use Entra ID?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows ShareServiceClient with DefaultAzureCredential and an Azure Files account URL.

faq.question: Does it support connection strings?
faq.answer: Yes. It demonstrates reading an Azure Storage connection string from a named environment variable.

faq.question: Can it handle large files?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance includes chunked downloads, byte-range operations, and asynchronous uploads.

faq.question: Does it create Azure storage accounts?
faq.answer: No. It manages file shares inside an existing account and assumes required permissions already exist.

faq.question: Are delete operations automatically safe?
faq.answer: No. Confirm exact targets and create a snapshot or backup before deleting shares, directories, or files.
